scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,MCP,A2A -c blue,magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @lai/web dev" "pnpm --filter @lai/mcp-server dev" "pnpm --filter @lai/a2a-server dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @lai/web build && pnpm --filter @lai/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @lai/a2a-server build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @lai/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @lai/mcp-server typecheck && pnpm --filter @lai/a2a-server typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run app:doctor && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && playwright test
